title: 训练期掩码质量与分类分数对齐
question: 若候选已正确覆盖目标，能否在训练期让分类分数反映实例掩码质量，从而降低候选排序造成的掩码质量遗憾？
gt_role: training supervision only; inference remains GT-free
method: one-to-one auxiliary BCE aligning class logits with detached soft mask IoU targets
result: Implementation smoke passed, but 100-image 3-epoch pilot decreased Mask mAP50-95 by 1.09 pp; route paused pending a new quality-target design
